source: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF), Department of Agricultural Extension — trifold "វិធីបណ្តុះកូនល្ហុង" (Method for Raising Papaya Seedlings), citing Training Module on Fruit Tree Production (2013) and a farmer's field experience from Kampong district, Preah Vihear province (2012)
text:
For the nursery bags, mix good topsoil with well-decomposed cattle manure and rice-husk ash (roughly 4 parts soil to 1 part decomposed manure to 1 part husk ash, based on the diagram of soil + manure + ash shown in the source). This gives the young seedlings a light, fertile growing medium.

Fill nursery bags of about 4 x 7 cm with this soil mix and arrange them in rows under the shaded nursery area before sowing the pre-soaked seeds.
caveat: The exact soil:manure:ash ratio is inferred from an illustrated diagram (soil icon + manure icon + ash icon side by side) rather than a spelled-out ratio in the body text; treat the '4:1:1' figure as approximate, not a confirmed exact ratio.
